name: Precision 3D Helper
tagline: Front-desk and machine-side helper for a small 3D printing shop
description: It covers the front desk of a small printing shop: answering the customer questions that repeat weekly, quoting jobs with quantity breaks worked out, and steering each print to a sensible material and colour. It also preps models for the printer and helps troubleshoot Bambu Lab machines when something goes wrong.
author: srinimaram
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
